title: excoecaria cochinchinensis var. viridis
intro: Excoecaria cochinchinensis var. viridis, commonly known as the Poison Tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, characterized by its toxic latex that can cause skin irritation and eye problems. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The health benefits of Excoecaria cochinchinensis var. viridis include its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
